== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rogue Squadron X-wing (Errata)]] (<code>1263_34</code>, Virtual Block 6.3 slip 3-34), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The Virtual Block 6.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-34-Rogue_Squadron_X_wing.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-roguesquadronxwing-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Rogue Squadron X-wing]]; the Master List (2013) prints the original too.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p890420 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 9 July 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p890420. Icons the post writes out are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. While Rebel Aces on table, pilot is forfeit +2 and, if in battle, this card may not be lost before the damage segment. Matching starship for any Rogue Squadron pilot.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1263_34</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-34-Rogue_Squadron_X_wing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B38 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
